reserves.name: Strata Senior USDe deployed strategy positions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Strata senior-tranche strategy and Ethena sUSDe

reserveReview.rationale: Strata documents srUSDe as the senior ERC-4626 tranche of its Ethena market, with USDe as base asset and sUSDe as the yield source managed by the strategy. The deployed balance is therefore a protocol position linked to tracked sUSDe and inherits Ethena basis, counterparty, market, and cooldown liquidity risks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live ERC-4626 deployed balance captured 2026-09-21 and current Strata market documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct deployed position is identified as the Strata senior-tranche strategy over sUSDe; changing internal USDe and sUSDe balances are not separately weighted by the live adapter.
